name.ja: BB戦士348 馬謖ガンダム

description.ja: • 三国伝外伝第７弾、鮮烈なる俊英「馬謖ガンダム」登場。 • 巨大な剣「巨斬半月刀」付き、背中に装着も可能。 成型品×3、シール×1、組立説明書（マンガ有）×1
description.en: • In the 7th installment of Sangokuden Gaiden, the brilliant and talented "Bayo Gundam " appears. • Comes with a giant sword " Kyozan Hanto", which can also be attached to the back. Molded product x 3, Seal x 1, Assembly manual (manga included) x 1
